scheme_name: Award Of Scholarships To Young Artists In Different Cultural Fields
other_conditions: Candidate must be an Indian national
Candidate should have adequate general education to pursue training effectively
Candidate must demonstrate desire to pursue the training effectively
Candidate must have already acquired a degree of proficiency in the chosen field
Candidate must have undergone a minimum of 5 years of training with their Guru/Institute
Candidate must submit a certificate duly signed by the present Guru/Institute and former Guru/Institute (if any)
Candidate should have adequate knowledge of the connected arts/disciplines
benefits_summary: Each scholar receives ₹5,000 per month for two years (total of 400 scholarships).
documents_required: Certificate duly signed by the present Guru / Institute and former Guru/ Institute (if any)
